The full proposal

Hosting, handoff, monthly costs, ownership and the fine print, for when you want every detail.

How payment works

You never pay the full price up front. Every build is paid in stages that match the work done: 50% to start, 25% as the work takes shape, and the final 25% when it goes live. For the website, that’s a $197.50 deposit to begin, which is 50% of $395.

The Business System price may change based on scope, complexity, and the number of features.

Complete handoff: $40 CAD / month

Subject to change.

When the site is handed over to you, everything behind it stays hosted and kept running:

  • The website itself, online around the clock
  • The database that stores your quote requests and leads
  • User logins, so you and your team can sign in securely
  • File storage for your photos and documents
  • Automated backups, so the site and your leads can be restored
  • Security, including the SSL certificate, the padlock visitors look for
  • Email sending for quote notifications and confirmations

Self-service — the AI builder (you do it): The handoff also includes the AI-assisted builder. No code. You manage the site in natural language, in plain, everyday words, and update and manage it yourself easily. Each client gets their own builder, and access is handed over to you when the site is done. The builder is included in the $40 CAD a month, there is no separate charge for it. *Limited usage applies.

Some services may carry yearly or additional fees depending on what your site uses, for example payment processing (Stripe), heavy AI usage, a premium SSL security certificate, yearly domain renewal, email hosting, extra storage or bandwidth, and map or review integrations. Those are charged by the provider and passed through at cost.

Services — Protiva does it for you (separate from the builder)

The services below are not the builder. They are work you hire Protiva to do for you, if you would rather not do it yourself.

If you’d rather we run it: the management retainer, ask for a quote

Protiva can manage the site for you instead: hosting and care included, up to 4 content updates a month (text changes, photo swaps, new project photos, seasonal tweaks), priority support, and a short monthly report on the site and its leads. Extra changes beyond the plan are quoted up front. Ask for a quote, the retainer is priced after a short audit of your setup, and you can cancel any time. No fixed monthly price is listed, because the price depends on your setup.

Fixes, updates and new features, available for hire

If you need a fix, an update, or a new feature added, that work is available for hire. A few small tweaks — a typo, a phone number, a photo swap — are straightforward to request. Bigger work, like a new page or a new feature, is quoted up front before anything starts. Each job is quoted on its own. You approve the quote first, then the work begins.

Your domain and email

edmundslandscaping.com already belongs to Edmunds Landscaping, and buying this site doesn’t change that. We set up the domain and point it at the new site so it loads again. It stays registered in your name, at your registrar, under your control: you pay the registrar’s yearly renewal and we handle the settings and reminders.

If you want email on your domain (for example john@edmundslandscaping.com), we can set up mailboxes through Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 in your name, at the provider’s per-mailbox rate. Keeping your current email works too.

Ownership

You own the site, the content, the files and the tech outright. At launch you get the logins, domain, hosting and site admin, all registered to Edmunds Landscaping. If you ever move on, everything goes with you. Nothing is held hostage, and there’s no fee to leave.

Getting found: Google and AI answers

The site is set up to be found three ways. SEO (Search Engine Optimization): your pages carry the words homeowners actually search, and the site loads fast on phones. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): your services, guarantee and reviews are stated clearly and structured so AI assistants can quote Edmunds Landscaping when someone asks who builds interlocking patios in Toronto. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): the same accurate facts are kept consistent across your site and profiles, so AI-generated summaries describe you correctly.

With the Business System ($2,999 $1,995): what’s behind it

  • The audit: before anything is built, we map how enquiries reach you today, website, phone, Instagram, inbox, and where leads get lost.
  • Implementation: the CRM is configured to how you run jobs: lead stages from new request to quoted to booked, the details you need on every job, and automated follow-up sequences for leads who haven’t booked.
  • Your data: every lead lives in a database that belongs to Edmunds Landscaping, backed up regularly and exportable to a spreadsheet any time you ask.
  • Analytics: see where each lead came from, how many quote requests come in, and which turn into booked jobs.
  • Email notifications: every quote request lands in your inbox, and the homeowner gets an instant confirmation.
  • Training and handover: we walk you through the system, hand over a short written quick-start guide and every login, so you can run it yourself from day one.
  • Optional e-commerce add-on ($1,000): sell online with card payments on the site, plus automatic follow-ups for shoppers who start a purchase and leave.

02 Services

What we build

Full service landscape construction for residential homes across the GTA, from the front entrance to the back fence.

Stone Porches and Steps

Entrance ways rebuilt in natural stone, with solid steps that make the front of the house feel finished.

Interlocking Pavers

Driveways, patios and walkways using Unilock, Permacon, Banas, Techo Bloc, Best Way Stone and more.

Retaining Walls

Structural and garden walls that hold grade, manage slopes and give tiered yards a clean, usable shape.

Walkways and Patios

Flagstone set in mortar or on a sand base, laid out for how your family actually moves through the yard.

Gardens and Planting

Garden installation and planting that softens the stone work and gives the space colour through the seasons.

Landscape Lighting

Low voltage lighting that makes steps safe, stone glow after dark, and patios usable into the evening.

Carpentry and Fencing

Custom carpentry and fencing built to match the stone work, not fight with it.

Artificial Turf

Artificial turf and playground flooring for low maintenance play areas that stay green all year.

3D Design

Simple, clean 3D designs so you can see the project before we break ground, planned to meet your budget.

03 About

Meet John Edmunds

John founded Edmunds Landscaping in 2013, after nearly 20 years in the landscape construction industry. He knows the trade from the ground up because he spent two decades working in it before putting his own name on the truck.

As a husband and father of two young boys, John builds the kind of outdoor spaces he would want at his own home: functional first, beautiful second, and safe for kids to grow up in. That family lens shapes every porch, patio and play area the company builds across the GTA.
